rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF CECILIA BUENAVENTURA
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #1, Report, Fees, Final Distribution
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 08/25/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) The petition for final distribution must state specifically how the estate is to be distributed to each distributee, including the net amount of cash (as of a date certain) to be distributed to each beneficiary (LRSF 14.35.I.7.a). 2) The extraordinary fee requests fees related to the sale of the real property, which was sold at a loss. A petition for extraordinary services must show the benefit of the services to the estate (CRC 7.702(3)). In a supplemental declaration, please clarify how the work performed helped the estate. 3) The extraordinary fee request is for roughly $17,000, and the statutory fee request is roughly $11,000. Please clarify how much time was incurred on ordinary services related to this estate's administration. 4) No proposed order has been received or lodged with the court (LRSF 14.7.A). Please address the above issues and delivery courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 08/11/2026 to avoid additional continuance.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF PETER HEMPSTEAD SISSON
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 9/1/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) A person seeking to be appointed as a fiduciary must sign and verity his own pleading(s), including any supplement or amendment to a petition (or "declaration"). [CRC 7.103(c).] (2) What is Deborah Yeagley's relationship to the decedent? Please provide a courtesy copy of any papers filed to address these issues to the assigned examiner by 8/18/26. [LRSF 2.7 B. and 14.7 B.] A supplement to the petition, prepared on pleading paper and signed and verified by the petitioner, should suffice to address these issues (statement about liabilities and disclosure of Deborah Yeagley's relationship to the decedent). Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF GENE PAUL REXRODE
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/01/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) Please explain why an estate this size ($0) requires a administration. 2) Bond is required for out of state residents. A declaration setting forth in detail the anticipated liabilities of the decedent and claims against the estate is required to determine appropriate bond. (San Francisco Local Rule 14.16.F). 3) Petition is incomplete. In Item 5a, box (3) or (4) must be checked. Item 6 is left blank, although it appears to apply. 4) The relationship to the decedent must be stated for all persons listed in Item 8. 5) No Confidential Statement of Birth Date and Driver's License Number (Form DE-147S) has been filed (San Francisco Local Rule 14.18.E). 6) No proof of publication has been filed (Probate Code Sections 8120 and 8121). 7) No Notice of Petition to Administer Estate (Form DE-121) has been filed (Probate Code Section 8100). All notices must include language about remote appearances (San Francisco Local Rule 14.1.C.6). Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 08/19/2026 to avoid additional continuance.
